'''Meat pizza''' is a type of [[pizza]] that restores 16 [[Hitpoints]] in total, 2 bites each healing for 8. It can be obtained by using [[cooked meat]] or [[cooked chicken]] on a [[plain pizza]], requiring 45 [[Cooking]] and granting 26 experience.

When the first bite is eaten, the message {{Mes|You eat half of the meat pizza.}}is displayed. The second bite gives the message {{Mes|You eat the remaining meat pizza.}}.

{{Instructions
|step1 = Use a [[pot of flour]] with either a [[bucket of water]], [[bowl of water]], or [[jug of water]] to create a [[pizza base]]
|step2 = Add a [[tomato]] to the [[pizza base]] to create an [[incomplete pizza]]
|step3 = Add a [[cheese]] to the [[incomplete pizza]] to create an [[uncooked pizza]]
|step4 = Use the [[uncooked pizza]] on a [[range]] to create a [[plain pizza]] (or, if burnt, a [[burnt pizza]])
|step5 = Use [[cooked meat]] or [[cooked chicken]] on the [[plain pizza]] to make a meat pizza
}}

==Trivia==
* Though the whole pizza weighs 0.83 kg, half the pizza is only 0.25 kg, which is 30% less. This is the same for [[anchovy pizza]] and [[pineapple pizza]].
* Eating a meat pizza results in less healing than eating its ingredients separately. Eating a whole plain pizza (14 hitpoints) and cooked meat or chicken (3 hitpoints) heals a total of 17 hitpoints.
* [[Cooked chicken (undead)]] and [[cooked meat (undead)]] '''cannot''' be used to make a meat pizza. Attempting to do so results in ''Nothing interesting happens.''
